## Request and behavior

Link the issue and specification. State acceptance criteria and non-goals.

## Verification

Describe the observed failing regression test, implementation, passing tests, and unchanged behavior. Attach actual commands/results, not predicted outcomes. Call out tests not run.

## Governance and security

Explain permission, allocation, trace, credential, publication or schema effects. State any live-provider checks still required. Do not attach private prompts, tokens or live user traces.
